auth__signup__error: Unable to create your account right now.

auth__forgot__sent_description: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way. The link expires in an hour.
auth__forgot__error: Unable to send the reset email right now.
auth__reset__description: Pick a password you have not used before on {name}.
auth__reset__invalid_token: That reset link has expired or already been used. Request a new one.
auth__reset__missing_token: This page needs a reset link from your email. Request one to continue.

shell__wren_idle: I am here when you need a hand.
signin__local_why: That is our pick for a first visit. Your work stays right here, there is nothing to sign up for, and you can bring in a Fabric account whenever you want to put something online.
signin__back_title: Pick up where you left off.
signin__back_why: Your projects are waiting on this computer, exactly as you left them.
signin__busy_why: Just a moment. I am getting everything ready.
signin__offline_title: Start on this computer, for now.
signin__offline_why: Fabric cannot be reached at the moment, so this is the way in that works right now. Everything you make stays safe here.
signin__or_fabric_sub: Keep your work in the cloud.
signin__fabric_body: Your work is kept safe in your Fabric account and follows you to your phone. You will sign in on Fabric's own page.
signin__code_steps: Open the page, check the code matches, and say yes. I will notice and carry on.
signin__code_expired: That code ran out of time.
signin__offline_alert_body: Your internet looks to be offline, so signing in is not possible right now. Nothing has been lost, and you can carry on on this computer.
signin__legal: By continuing you agree to Fabric's terms. We never read what you build on this computer.
ai__pick_title: We would pick Fabric's own AI.
ai__pick_why: It answers in a few seconds, there is nothing to install, and it is already part of your plan. This computer could run a smaller AI too, but it would be slower and take a few minutes to get ready.
ai__only_title: Fabric's own AI is the one to use.
ai__only_why: We looked on this computer and found no other AI set up, so there is nothing else to choose between yet. It answers in a few seconds and needs nothing installed.
ai__hint: You can change this any time in Settings. I will never switch it without asking.
ai__key_title: An AI account you already have
ai__key_body: Use your own account. They bill you directly, the same as today.
ai__sub_title: A subscription you already pay for
ai__sub_body: Sign in with the plan you have and keep using it here.
ai__none_title: Nothing else to choose from yet.
ai__none_body: No other AI is set up on this computer, and no accounts are connected. That is fine. When you want another one, add it in Settings and I will help you pick.
ai__loading_why: Checking what would work best here. This takes a moment.
newproject__title: Say what you want to build.
newproject__why: That is the fastest way to start. A rough sentence is enough. In a few minutes you will see a first draft, and nothing goes online until you say so.
newproject__label: What do you want to build?
newproject__placeholder: For example: a booking page for my baking classes, where people can pick a day and pay.
newproject__hint: Type a sentence to begin. You can change where it lives later.
newproject__failed_body: Nothing was built and nothing was changed. Your words are still here.
newproject__ideas_sub: Pick one and I will write the first sentence for you.
newproject__idea_business_d: Say who you are, what you offer and how to reach you.
newproject__idea_booking_d: People pick a time. You get a note. No back and forth.
newproject__idea_shop_d: Show what you sell and take payments, simply.
newproject__idea_club_d: News, events and members, all in one place.
newproject__idea_tracker_d: Keep track of jobs, people or stock without a spreadsheet.
newproject__idea_phone_d: Something people keep on their home screen.
newproject__idea_business_s: A website for my business that says who I am, what I offer and how to reach me.
newproject__idea_booking_s: A booking page where people pick a time and I get a note.
newproject__idea_shop_s: A small shop that shows what I sell and takes payments.
newproject__idea_club_s: A hub for my club with news, events and members.
newproject__idea_tracker_s: A tracker for my team to follow jobs, people or stock.
newproject__idea_phone_s: An app for phones that people keep on their home screen.
plan__intro: Wren builds your app one step at a time and checks each step before moving on. This is the plan, and how far along it is.
plan__empty: Tell Wren what you want to build and the plan appears here.
publish__title: Put your app on the internet
publish__intro: Publishing makes your app available online, so other people can use it. Right now only you can see it.
publish__fabric_body: One step. Fabric puts your app on the internet and gives you a web address to share with your guests. It takes about a minute.
publish__fabric_sign_in: Sign in to Fabric first, then come back here to publish.
publish__fabric_not_in: This project is not in your Fabric account yet. Open Fabric to add it.
publish__elsewhere_intro: Prefer a different home for your app? Wren can set it up. Each of these is a message you give to Wren. It adds what your app needs for that place and asks you for any accounts or passwords.
publish__standalone: On my own computer or server
publish__standalone_body: Your app runs as one program that you start yourself. A good choice if you have a computer or server of your own.
publish__cloudflare_body: A fast host with a free starting plan. You will need a Cloudflare account.
publish__serverless_body: Your app only runs when someone visits, on a big cloud such as Amazon. You pay for what gets used.
publish__azure_body: Microsoft's cloud. A good choice if your company already uses it. You will need an Azure account.
logs__intro: What your app is saying while you build it. Problems come first; every line is below.
logs__quiet: Nothing is wrong. Your app is running quietly.
logs__empty: Nothing here yet. Your app's messages show up once it is running.
org__signed_out_title: Sign in with Fabric to see this
org__signed_out_body: Your team, plan and AI suppliers live in your Fabric account. Sign in on the first screen and come back.
org__none: You are not in a team yet.
team__intro: Everyone who can open this team's apps, and anyone who has been invited but has not joined yet.
team__invite_failed: The invite did not go out. Check the address and try again.
team__invite_sent: Invite sent. The link works for 14 days.
team__waiting_empty: Nobody is waiting. Invites you send show up here until they are used.
team__roles_owner: Runs the team. Everything, including the plan, billing and closing the team.
team__roles_admin: Looks after people and AI suppliers. Cannot change the plan or close the team.
team__roles_member: Opens every app and builds in them. Cannot manage people or money.
billing__intro: What you pay, what you have left, and how it is topped up.
billing__order: Spent in that order: monthly credit first, bought credit last.
billing__buy_sub: From $5 to $500. It is yours until used.
billing__auto_sub: Add credit by itself so work never stops.
billing__auto_off: Off. When your credit reaches $0, builds, workspaces and AI pause until you add more.
billing__auto_on: On. When your credit drops to {threshold}, we add {amount}.
billing__blocked_body: Your credit has run out. Add credit to start builds, workspaces and AI again.
plans__intro: Pick what fits. You can change it later, and nothing is lost when you do.
plans__free_blurb: Pay as you go. You only pay for what you use.
plans__pro_blurb: For one person running real apps.
plans__team_blurb: For a small team working on apps together.
plans__free_facts: No monthly credit|1 app|1 live copy|1 person
plans__pro_facts: $15 credit each month|5 apps|3 live copies per app|Your own web address|Always on|1 person
plans__team_facts: $50 credit each month|20 apps|5 live copies per app|Your own web address|Always on|5 people
plans__failed: The plan did not change. Try again in a moment.
suppliers__intro: Choose who provides each AI company for this team.
suppliers__fabric_note: Fabric supplies it and charges what it costs plus 10%.
suppliers__own_note: Key ending {hint}. The company bills you directly. Fabric still counts the usage.
suppliers__key_failed: That key did not work. Check it and try again.
suppliers__limits_sub: When a limit is used up, that model stops for that scope until the period starts over.
suppliers__limits_empty: No limits. AI spend is not capped.
spend__intro: What AI has cost, which models used it and who asked for it.
spend__requests_note: Each time an AI answered something
spend__tokens_note: Counted in tokens, small pieces of text
spend__empty: No AI use in this time.
tr__intro: Everything your app says, side by side in every language. Fill in what is missing and it saves as you go.
tr__summary: {languages} languages, {missing} pieces of wording still need translating
tr__hint: Type a translation and click away. It saves by itself.
tr__empty: Nothing to translate yet. Wording appears here once your app has some.
emails__intro: These are the emails your app sends by itself. Look at how each one reads, in each language, before it reaches real people. Nothing on this page sends anything.
emails__empty: Your app does not send any emails yet. Ask Wren to add one.
emails__preview_failed: The preview could not be made.
emails__pick: Pick an email and a language to see it.
list__agents_intro: The AI helpers inside your app. They talk with your visitors for you, and each one can only do the things listed here.
list__agents_empty: No assistants yet. Ask Wren to add one.
list__workflows_intro: Jobs with several steps that your app carries out by itself, even when a step has to wait hours or days.
list__schedulers_intro: Jobs your app does on its own at set times, like sending reminders every afternoon.
list__queues_intro: Work that should not make anyone wait, like sending a confirmation email. Your app puts it in a waiting line and works through it.
list__triggers_intro: Things that start work in your app when something happens in another service, like a card payment arriving.
list__triggers_empty: Your app is not listening for anything yet.
list__outgoing_intro: When something happens in your app, it can tell other services, like your accounting app.
list__outgoing_empty: Your app does not send any messages out yet.
list__secrets_intro: Passwords and keys your app needs. The values are never shown here.
list__secrets_empty: Your app does not need any secrets yet.
list__variables_intro: Choices your app reads when it starts, like a name or a web address.
list__variables_empty: Your app has no settings yet.
list__flags_intro: Turn parts of your app on or off without changing it.
list__roles_intro: The kinds of people who use your app, and what each kind may do.
list__permissions_intro: The things people can be allowed to do in your app.
list__credentials_intro: The other services your app signs in to for you.
list__credentials_empty: Your app is not connected to other services yet.
list__personas_intro: The pretend visitors used to try your app out before real people do.
list__personas_empty: No pretend visitors yet. Ask Wren to add some.
list__failed: This list could not be loaded.
newteam__intro: A team is a shared place for people, apps and one bill. You will be its owner.
newteam__name_note: You cannot change the name later, so check it.
newteam__slug_note: We fill this in from the name. Edit it if you like.
newteam__note: The team exists as soon as you press the button. If you do not finish paying, it stays on the Free plan.
newteam__failed: The team could not be created. The address may already be taken.
invite__intro: You have been invited to join this team on Fabric.
invite__expired: This invitation has run out. Ask the team owner to send you a new one.
invite__used: This invitation has already been used.
invite__failed: You could not join. Sign in with the invited email and try again.
invite__missing: We could not find this invitation.
tsettings__intro: The name and web address of this team.
tsettings__name_fixed: A team's name cannot be changed after it is created. Only the address can.
tsettings__slug_note: 3 to 39 characters. Lowercase letters, numbers and single dashes.
tsettings__slug_safe: Nothing breaks when you change it. Old links keep working for 90 days and send people to the new address.
tsettings__failed: The address could not be saved. It may already be taken.
tsettings__close_note: This is permanent. Everything in the team is removed. Think before you start.
knowledge__intro: The notes your app and Wren keep about how it works and why. Wren reads these before changing anything.
knowledge__empty: No notes yet. They appear as Wren builds your app.
signin__options_intro: How people get into your app. Each way needs its keys saved before it works.
signin__options_empty: Your app only uses email and password.
screens__intro: Every page your visitors can open, and which app it belongs to.
screens__empty: Your app has no pages yet.
db__intro: Where your app keeps its information. Each box is a kind of thing it remembers, and the lines show what belongs to what.
db__empty: Your app does not store anything yet.
db__count: {tables} kinds of information, {columns} details in all
checks__intro: A health check of your app. It looks for broken pieces before your visitors do.
checks__none: The checks have not been run yet.
design__intro: How your app looks right now.
design__empty: There is no preview yet. Wren builds one as your app takes shape.
proposed__alerts_intro: Choose what you want to hear about, like errors or running low on credit, and where the message should reach you.
proposed__alerts_body: You cannot set alerts up yet. For now, ask Wren to keep an eye on something and it will tell you.
proposed__history_intro: Every time an alert went off, with the logs from that moment.
proposed__reach_intro: Updates in the app, email or a chat message, and when you would rather not be disturbed.
proposed__reach_body: For now, updates reach you inside the app only.
proposed__activity_intro: Who did what in your app, and when.
proposed__credit_intro: What your app's AI has used, and a warning before it runs out.
proposed__credit_body: Spend for your team is in Cloud, under AI spend.
proposed__artifacts_intro: The files and documents your app has made.
proposed__artifacts_body: No files have been saved yet.
proposed__home_intro: What needs you, what ran, and what Wren is working on.
proposed__home_body: Your home fills up once your app has been running for a while.
proposed__things_intro: Everything running on your behalf, with when it last ran and how it went.
proposed__things_body: Nothing runs on its own yet. Ask Wren to set something up.
proposed__accounts_intro: The limited identities your routines run as, and what each may touch.
proposed__accounts_body: No helper accounts yet. One is made when a routine is set up.
proposed__newroutine_intro: Describe something to do on a schedule and Wren sets it up with the smallest access it needs.
proposed__newroutine_body: Routines are set up by asking Wren for now.
proposed__routine_intro: What one routine runs as, what it can touch, and anything it was stopped from doing.
proposed__routine_body: Open a routine from Things it does.
proposed__helpers_intro: Helpers that act for your routines, and which routines use each.
proposed__conversation_intro: Talk with Wren about your app. It builds and looks after it for you.
proposed__conversation_body: Use the box at the bottom of the screen to start.
proposed__cards_intro: Things Wren shows you in the conversation, like a preview or a choice to make.
proposed__cards_body: Cards appear here as Wren shows them.
proposed__chat_intro: Try one of your assistants the way a visitor would.
proposed__chat_body: Trying an assistant here is coming soon.
proposed__quality_intro: Grades for what your assistants say, so you notice if answers get worse.
proposed__quality_body: Quality checks are set up for you by Wren.
proposed__stories_intro: Short scripts of what a visitor does, run against your app to check it still works.
proposed__stories_body: No stories yet. Ask Wren to write some.
proposed__visitors_intro: Pretend visitors that use your app like a person would.
proposed__visitors_body: No pretend visitors are running yet.
proposed__requests_intro: Every visit your app handled, with whether it worked.
proposed__requests_body: Requests are not listed here yet.
proposed__addons_intro: Ready-made pieces you can add to your app, like payments or maps.
proposed__addons_body: The add-on shop is coming soon. Ask Wren to add one.

home__ask: Ask Wren what to do next
home__ask_message: What should I do next with my app?

visitors__empty: No pretend visitors yet. Ask Wren to add some.

setup__ai_hint: The helper that does the building.

setup__help: Build it like a website. Fabric keeps it running, and fixes it when something breaks.

shell__recent_empty: Projects you start will show up here.
shell__bell_ask: Is there anything that needs me?
newproject__where_offline: An offline app I can sell
signin__wren: Hi, I am Wren. I will be here the whole way, and I will always ask before I change anything that matters.
ai__wren: I would go with Fabric's AI. It is the quickest start, and you can change your mind any time.
newproject__wren: Tell me what you are picturing. Rough is fine. I will ask before I build anything.
